newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takuma shares surge on plant order.
newsitem.headline: Takuma shares surge on plant order.

text.p: Shares in Takuma Co Ltd rose to a record high for the calendar year on Tuesday morning after the firm received a large order for an incinerator plant, traders said.
By 0051 GMT, Takuma had surged 60 yen to 1,620 yen, its highest level so far this calendar year.
Turnover was 603,000 shares, making it the sixth most actively traded issue in the first section of TSE.
Takuma said on Tuesday it had won a 36.28 billion yen contract for a garbage incinerator plant from the city of Sapporo in northern Japan.
